objective: Replace the rounding-only navigation uncertainty of Synthetic-v1 with a physically layered, empirically calibrated forward model while keeping calibration, prediction, and validation datasets disjoint.

outputs: position covariance or empirical error envelope
expected response distribution, not deterministic target label

NUISANCE.rule: All regimes and parameter extraction rules must be frozen before unseen validation results are inspected.

calibration_dataset.dataset: Hannah/BODC CD169 originator-supplied veh_nav plus commands provenance

unseen_validation_contract.required_independence: Different real survey/cruise or otherwise genuinely unseen acquisition not used to fit V2 parameters.
primary_metrics: sample-index error when ground truth permits

success_rule.required_reporting: Report each preregistered metric for V1 and V2 separately, including negative results and tail errors.
success_rule.methodological_improvement: May be claimed only from unseen validation metrics, never from CD169 calibration fit.
